PAGINATION_PROJECT_A
2026 - 2027
Repository: https://example.com/project-a
Stack: TypeScript + Python + Chromium
Synthetic project used only to exercise a real print-fragmentation boundary.
  • PAGINATION_BULLET_A1 First complete bullet stays with the project metadata and remains indivisible at the page boundary.
  • PAGINATION_BULLET_A2 Second complete bullet moves to the following page without splitting across both pages.
  • PAGINATION_BULLET_A3 Third complete bullet follows on the second page and remains an independent fragment.
